title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Organizations - Organization
description: A public administration organization in Spain, and its place in an organization chart (edintorg:Organization, subclass of W3C org:Organization). Collapses the source ontology's two subclasses (OrganicUnit, PublicLawEntity), which declare no properties of their own, into this single entity -- the hasOrganizationType enum below already captures similar distinctions in practice.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Organization'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

hasOrganizationType.description: Property. The organization's type, from the official Spanish public-sector OrganizationType taxonomy's own 2-letter codes (edintorg:hasOrganizationType) -- e.g. AY=Town Council, MN=Ministry, CA=Autonomous Community, UN=University, FN=Foundation, ZZ=Unclassified. Codes used rather than English glosses because two codes (AE, OC) share the same English label ('State Agency') in the source's own SKOS vocabulary despite being distinct concepts.

hasAdministrationLevel.description: Property. The administration level the organization belongs to (edintorg:hasAdministrationLevel). NOTE: the source ontology's own AdministrationLevel SKOS concept scheme has a data bug -- all 5 concepts are declared under the identical URI 'edintkosadmlev:1' (copy-paste error, notation '1' through '5' never updated in the identifier itself); rebuilt as 5 distinct enum values here from each concept's own skos:notation and prefLabel rather than reproducing the broken shared URI.

dependsOnRoot.description: Relationship. The organization at the highest level of hierarchy this organization depends on (edintorg:dependsOnRoot, self-referential to another Organization).

hasCompeteceRegion.description: Relationship. The administrative region where the organization exercises its powers (edintorg:hasCompeteceRegion) -- a Municipio, Provincia, Autonomia, Comarca or Distrito. These territorial classes are external to this ontology and not modeled as entities here; kept as an opaque Relationship, same treatment as Facility.belongsTo in edint-infraestructura. (Property name 'hasCompeteceRegion' is copied verbatim from the source, including its apparent typo for 'hasCompetenceRegion'.)

hierarchicalLevel.description: Property. The organization's relative hierarchical level within the entity it belongs to; 0 for the root of an administrative level (edintorg:hierarchicalLevel).

externalIdentifier.description: Property. External code designating the organization according to the coding system of the data source it came from (edintorg:externalIdentifier).

legalProvision.description: Property. Identification of the legal provision that regulates the organization's powers, e.g. a Royal Decree reference (edintorg:legalProvision).

deregistrationNote.description: Property. Notes related to the organization's deregistration, if applicable (edintorg:deregistrationNote).
